gt_provenance.details: GT provenance appears valid for this fc-only audit. The ground truth is not externally fabricated: fc unit index corresponds to the ImageNet class label by architecture/dataset construction, and this mapping is enforced by an assert in code (assert np.all(fc_class_lbls == fc_local_idx)). Acceptable provenance for the tested 1000 fc components.

score_normalization.details: Normalization appears proper. The variant uses L2-normalized cosine similarity for retrieval/scoring, consistent with the claim's text-queryable cosine-search framing. The permutation baseline is an independent random shuffle (no dependence leakage from observed ranking).

result_existence.details: All claimed artifacts present on disk: result.json, result_p2a.json, result_p2b.json, v_c_crp.h5, verdict.json. Metrics are internally coherent: mrr=0.9024, significant=true, perm95=0.00968, stability_median_cos=0.9581, passes=true, n_valid_components=1000/1000 (no degenerate zero vectors).

dead_code.details: All metric functions are called in v_crp_recover.py: compute_mrr (P2a MRR and R@10), permutation_upper (perm95 bound), compute_stability (P2b disjoint-half cosine). Outputs verified in result.json.

scope.details: The tested result supports a narrower conclusion than the full wording of claim C2. This variant shows fc-layer components on ImageNet-val with LRP-epsilon CRP 90th-percentile relevance cropping still yield highly class-recoverable vectors (MRR 0.9024, significant). However, this is a method-swapped preprocessing variant; it supports robustness of C2 under CRP-crop composition for fc components but is not direct confirmation of the unmodified general claim across broader component types or preprocessing choices.
